sentences.text:
Present: Mr.
Sanjeev Kumar Suri, Advocate, vice Mr. Sanjay Kumar Sharma, Advocate, for the petitioner.
M/s Jitender Sharma, Baldev Negi, Pushpender Jaswal, Additional Advocate Generals, with

Mr.
Gautam Sood, Deputy Advocate General, for respondent No.1State.

Mr. Vivek Sharma, Advocate, vice Mr. Diwan Singh Negi, Advocate, for respondent No.2.
Respondent No.2 is present in person.
Respondent No.2 is present in person.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and after perusing the Compromise Deed, this Court is of the considered view that it would be in the interest of justice in case this petition is taken up for consideration after the entire amount as agreed, is paid to respondent No.2complainant by the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that hearing of the case be deferred by about six weeks.

He further submits that in the interest of justice and further taking into consideration the fact that the parties have already approached learned Family Court for mutual .
divorce, the trial of the case be ordered to be stayed.
As prayed for, list after six weeks.

As the request of learned counsel appears to be genuine, therefore,
during the pendency of the proceedings, the trial in Police Challan No.390 of 2021, r present titled as State of H.P. Versus Ravi, pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate II, Shimla, District Shimla, H.P., arising out of FIR No.12 of 2021, dated 07.05.2021, registered under Sections 498A, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, at Women Police Station Shimla, District Shimla, H.P., shall remain stayed.
